targetText:
Not a fibre of it is changed, but a new social soul has popped into its
body.
explanation: Key theoretical concept in Reaction of the Agricultural Revolution on Industry. Creation of the Home-Market for Industrial Capital: Marxists analyze how structural economic conditions determine political and social relations under capitalism.

targetText:
[7] It therefore also, for the first time, conquers for
industrial capital the entire home market.
explanation: Modern relevance: understanding these underlying systemic dynamics helps clarify contemporary economic policies and labor movements.
